verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own budgeting capability: a marketing claim that finance teams can "set budgets and allocate spend limits with auto-enforced controls," plus a Budgets API for managing "budgets and budget programs," which covers program budgets and automatic enforcement. Department-scoped budgets are not explicitly documented, and the enforcement behavior rests only on a one-line marketing claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of budgets scoped to departments, detailed docs on how limits are enforced (declines, thresholds, approvals), independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: Set budgets and allocate spend limits with auto-enforced controls that empower employees to spend wisely.
Budgets API: Manage budgets and budget programs
